name: Gilberto Miranda
title: IT Infrastructure & Technical Support Professional
summary: IT professional with 20+ years in telecommunications, network engineering, and technical support. 89.98% truck roll prevention rate. Seeking remote/hybrid roles and freelance projects.

highlights: Resolve complex connectivity and equipment issues for business clients across voice, video, and data systems.
Prevent unnecessary field technician dispatches in 89.98% of cases through remote diagnostics.
Manage 4,100+ technical interactions annually with a 4.03/5 tech satisfaction score.
Document issues and resolutions in the internal knowledge base.
Designed, installed, and configured client LAN/WAN infrastructures and data communication systems.
Executed physical-to-virtual server migrations (Hyper-V → VMware), optimizing hardware resources.
Implemented system monitoring protocols for hardware integrity, server availability, and backup verification.

projects.name: Hermes v4 — Personal Automation System
projects.problem: After 4 failed attempts with OpenClaw and earlier Hermes versions, needed a reliable personal system to automate finances, sync data across cloud and local storage, and maintain operational continuity.
projects.solution: Designed and built a WSL2-based automation stack with unidirectional sync (rclone), scheduled cron jobs, and Obsidian-based documentation. Implemented checkpoint-based continuity.
projects.result: 20+ days of uninterrupted automated operation. Daily sync, financial tracking, and status reporting without manual intervention. Under 5 minutes/day maintenance.

projects.name: 89.98% Truck Roll Prevention Rate
projects.problem: Business clients at Spectrum frequently required on-site technician visits for issues that could be resolved remotely.
projects.solution: Developed deep diagnostic workflows for voice, video, and data services over coaxial and fiber infrastructure. Guided non-technical users through self-service tools and remote diagnostics.
projects.result: 89.98% truck roll prevention rate across 4,100+ annual interactions, with 4.03/5 tech satisfaction score.

projects.name: Multi-Site LAN/WAN Deployment
projects.problem: Small and medium businesses needed reliable, scalable network infrastructure across multiple physical sites with limited budgets.
projects.solution: Designed and deployed LAN/WAN environments for businesses with 100+ users. Handled physical installation, server configuration, network segmentation, and monitoring.
projects.result: Delivered stable multi-site networks with documented monitoring protocols and disaster recovery procedures.

projects.name: YouTube Knowledge Base & Tonal Analysis
projects.problem: Accumulated hundreds of YouTube transcripts but had no structured way to organize, evaluate, or extract value from them.
projects.solution: Built an automated pipeline that organizes transcripts into a structured vault (Obsidian), evaluates content quality using tonal analysis, and filters out low-value material.
projects.result: Processed 500+ transcripts, identified 80% as reliable sources, built a searchable personal knowledge base.
